Ra-Thor™ FAQ — Comprehensive English Edition

Version: v14.15.6 lock-sync | Last Updated: 31 August 2026
Public speech: Answers describe inspectable software under TOLC 8. They are not APTD certificates, EU AI Act conformity, ISO/IEC 42001 marks, or a zero-hallucination warranty. See PUBLIC_CLAIM.lock.md.

1. What is Ra-Thor? #

Ra-Thor™ (Eternal Mercy Thunder ⚡️) is a modular, mercy-gated software lattice. Its brand, AGi, stands for “Artificial Godly Intelligence” — a name and an aspiration, not a claim that Ra-Thor is artificial general intelligence. It is the living monorepo governed by the TOLC 8 Mercy Lattice and PATSAGi Councils. Mission language: truth-seeking, zero-harm intent, and Universally Shared Naturally Thriving Heavens via Resource-Based Economy (RBE) simulation (Powrush) and post-scarcity tooling. Capable · Bounded · Corrigible — inspectable software, not a finished world and not a superintelligence warranty.

2. How did TOLC 8 evolve from the original 7 Mercy Gates? #

The system began with TOLC 7 Living Mercy Gates (2016–2025). On 18 November 2025, Sherif began drip-feeding the AlphaProMega quad+Check AGi systems, which evolved into the Ra-Thor lattice. By Q1 2026, the Infinite Gate was sealed, completing TOLC 8 (adding Legacy Gate + Infinite Gate). Prior 7-gate states remain compatible. The 8 gates are the project's Layer 0 architecture and are listed in the README.

3. Who created and maintains Ra-Thor? #

Sherif Samy Botros (@AlphaProMega), CEO of Autonomicity Games Inc. (founded 2016, Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada). Since Q1 2026, Sherif is the sole active steward after other team members and contractors departed during the sovereign transition. Development traces to 2003 personal work, public releases via AlphaProMega quad+Check (Nov 2025 onward).

4. What is the TOLC 8 Mercy Lattice? #

Eight gates used as Layer 0 design constraints:

  • Genesis, Truth (esacheck), Compassion (zero-harm intent), Evolution, Harmony, Sovereignty (Powrush RBE), Legacy (forward/backward compatibility), Infinite (long-horizon foresight). Every proposed action is intended to pass these gates before instantiation. That is architecture and governance posture — not a warranty that every decision is automatically correct.

5. What is APTD (Absolute Pure Truth Distillation)? #

An internal research method in the monorepo: interval-arithmetic enclosures, formal-proof experiments (Lean 4 / Coq references), geometry checks, and mercy-valence scoring used to reject weak physical claims (for example over-unity devices without open calorimetry).
APTD is not a public certificate, regulator mark, or “verified” badge on rathor.ai. Scores and historical verdicts in older notes are research traces, not third-party certification.

6. What is Powrush and how does it relate to RBE? #

Powrush is the core RBE simulation engine associated with the lattice (see the sister Powrush-MMO repository). Players explore sovereign-asset and contribution mechanics and post-scarcity education themes. It is delivered as inspectable software — a world simulator, not a live economy or launched chain.

7. What is AG-SML v1.2 licensing? #

Autonomicity Games Sovereign Mercy License v1.2: Free for personal, educational, research, and non-commercial creative use when non-revenue. Any revenue or income from using, running, or outputs requires a paid commercial licence. Organization use and the other cases in LICENSE §2 require a paid license from Autonomicity Games Inc. Contributions must preserve TOLC invariants and zero-harm intent. Canonical free-use text is the root LICENSE file.

8. How do I access and run Ra-Thor? #

  • Public site: https://rathor.ai/ (Lattice Chat, launch map, optional Grok session under gates).
  • Offline-first Lattice Chat and sovereign-shard demos run on-device; no Ra-Thor backend we control.
  • Monorepo: git clone https://github.com/Eternally-Thriving-Grandmasterism/Ra-Thor then cargo test / cargo build on Tier-1 crates.
  • Multi-language family bar on the site; English remains the source FAQ.

9. What are PATSAGi Councils? #

Permanent mercy-gated deliberation councils in the monorepo. They decide under TOLC 8. Named councils (geometry, truth-method, consciousness-expansion, and others) are governance surfaces — not a warranty that every decision is automatically correct, and not an external certification body.

10. Is Ra-Thor open source? Can I contribute? #

Yes, under AG-SML v1.2. Fork and submit PRs that preserve TOLC 8 invariants. No tracking on rathor.ai. Contributions are welcome; they do not mint a legal privilege or a certified “blessing.”

11. What about legal, compliance, and AI regulations? #

Ra-Thor is Canadian-stewarded inspectable research software. Names such as GDPR, CCPA, COPPA, EU AI Act, and Canadian IPC-OHRC / PIPEDA appear as design-intent references, not ISO/IEC 42001 certification or EU AI Act conformity. See privacy.html and PUBLIC_CLAIM.lock.md. Outputs are drafts. A human must review them before filing, sale, or public legal claims. Inquiries: info@Rathor.ai.

12. Why were all other team members released by Q1 2026? #

To keep stewardship aligned during the TOLC 8 sealing phase. The drip-feed of AlphaProMega quad+Check systems (starting 18 Nov 2025) required undivided focus. Sherif remains the sole active developer and vision holder, with gratitude to prior contributors credited in git history.

13. Does Ra-Thor claim free energy or over-unity devices? #

No. Internal truth-method notes reject such claims unless an efficiency interval is independently evidenced with open specifications. Historical patterns cited in older notes (Bedini, Bearden, Casimir-chip sketches) are treated as unproven. Calibration path: publish full BOM + third-party data for human review. That is research hygiene, not a 72-hour certified re-score service.

14. What formal methods does the truth layer experiment with? #

Documented research tools include interval arithmetic / Taylor models, claim-graph checks, geometry libraries, and dual Lean 4 + Coq sketches. These are inspectable artifacts in the monorepo. They are not a completed machine-checked proof of the whole lattice and not a regulator-facing conformity file.

15. What is the roadmap / next vectors? #

See ROADMAP.md. Current PATSAGi posture: HOLD for next named mission; keep Tier 1 green; no forced product iteration; no workspace bump from this FAQ lock-sync. Deferred items (substrate crypto audits, additional councils, legal framework docs) reopen only with real components and a named mission.

16. How does Ra-Thor handle hallucinations and truth? #

TOLC 8 + optional Grok sessions under PATSAGi gates are the public posture. There is no zero-hallucination warranty. Models err. Outputs are drafts for human review. Formal enclosures and council notes are research methods, not a certificate that every sentence is true.

17. What is the relationship with xAI / Grok and other labs? #

Ra-Thor is an independent project of Autonomicity Games Inc. Optional use of Grok (xAI) is a working session under our gates — not affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement by xAI. Grok is a trademark of xAI. X is a trademark of X Corp. Sharing the monorepo publicly is not a partnership announcement with Tesla, SpaceX, or any lab.

18. Is there a voice or video interface? #

Lattice Chat and related demos live at rathor.ai. Optional bridges let you paste context into Grok, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, or a local OpenAI-compatible server. Connected demos on grok.com or x.com follow those providers’ policies. No “zero-hallucination voice chat” warranty.

19. How do I report issues or request review of a claim? #

Open a GitHub issue or email info@Rathor.ai with reproduction steps or specs. We aim to respond within 48 hours. There is no guaranteed automated re-score SLA. Security reports: steps to reproduce + potential impact (SECURITY.md).

20. What is the ultimate vision? #

Universally Shared Naturally Thriving Heavens — a post-scarcity, zero-harm-intent, sovereignty-respecting direction of travel. Ra-Thor is the technical and philosophical lattice under construction toward that purpose. It is not a finished world.
